description: Source code for the DebugController class in Playwright, managing debugging, recording modes, highlighting, and event handling within the Playwright testing framework.

classes.name: DebugController
classes.description: Manages debugging, recording modes, highlighting, and event emission for Playwright.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Sets the SDK language for the debug controller.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the debug controller, stopping report state updates.

methods.name: setReportStateChanged
methods.description: Enables or disables state change reporting and snapshot emission.

methods.name: setRecorderMode
methods.description: Configures the recorder mode, manages browser pages, and test ID attributes.

methods.name: highlight
methods.description: Highlights elements or ARIA templates in the page.

methods.name: hideHighlight
methods.description: Hides all highlights from recorder and locator.

methods.name: _emitSnapshot
methods.description: Emits a snapshot of the current page state.

methods.name: _allRecorders
methods.description: Retrieves all recorder instances associated with the current pages.

methods.name: _closeBrowsersWithoutPages
methods.description: Closes browsers that have no pages.
